def length_prefixed(s):
    """Produce a length-prefixed rendering of a piece of text, in the manner of
    classic wire-format conventions such as netstrings. s is a string. The
    formatted result announces, ahead of the payload itself, the number of
    characters that the reader should expect, with a single colon separating
    the count from the text that follows. Return exactly the string
    '<len>:<s>' where <len> is len(s) — the length, a colon, then s itself.
    The construction is purely a matter of string formatting; no
    interpretation of the contents of s is required.

    Examples:
    >>> length_prefixed('')
    '0:'
    >>> length_prefixed('abc')
    '3:abc'
    """
